name: Urijah
bio: Urijah the priest built a new altar in the Jerusalem temple to the exact design King Ahaz sent him from Damascus, copying a pagan altar Ahaz had seen there, and had it ready before the king returned. He carried out Ahaz's instructions to use this altar for all the regular offerings, relegating the LORD's own bronze altar to a secondary role at the king's command (2 Kings 16:10-16).
